messages:
olivia: FYI incident — staging retained auth tokens in logs for ~17m. Need scope, redaction plan, and comms sign-off. Details below.

sanjay: on it. can you DM me the exact log path?

olivia: /projects/redwood-staging/logs/auth-proxy

alex.k: cc @eng-sre @security — which services read that log?

olivia: only auth-proxy and auth-worker. ingestion pipeline pulled a small prod sample into staging last night (manual backfill)

mia: are there customer PII or just tokens?

olivia: tokens + email addresses in same lines. no SSNs, no cc numbers found in quick scan.

sanjay: starting redaction script now. Need write access to logging export to remove export bucket. @olivia can you approve?

olivia: Approved for sanjay for 1 hour. Grant least privilege.

jessica.comms: If prod not involved, we probably do internal comms only. Legal review?

nate.legal: quick note — we should avoid calling them "tokens" in external comms. Draft if we escalate. Otherwise internal incident note OK.

alex.k: action items: 1) snapshot current logs (olivia) 2) redact sensitive lines + purge exports (sanjay) 3) rotate any exposed tokens (security) 4) run search for other staging buckets (eng-sre) 5) comms hold (jessica/nate)

sanjay: redaction job started. ETA ~20m. found ~1,243 unique emails. 0 payment identifiers.

sec-bot: INC-2026-042 created by olivia — severity: low-medium — assets: staging auth-proxy

olivia: quick Q — do we need to notify affected users even though this is staging and subset was from prod sample?

nate.legal: not yet. wait for full scope. If any live accounts' tokens were actually valid in prod, escalate. For now, document and monitor.

jessica.comms: I'll draft an internal status update and a short Ops note for the console. sharing in #all-hands after legal OK.

alex.k: thanks. @sanjay please ping when redaction done and attach audit of rotated keys.

sanjay: redaction completed, export purged. rotation list attached to INC-2026-042. Revoke list: auth-sessions, api-keys for test accounts.

olivia: verified purge. closing external comms unless legal requests. closing config gap: disable backfill by default. will open PR.

mia: great. can we add automated log-scan rule to detect tokens appearing? low false pos? If yes, assign to eng-ml.

alex.k: assign to eng-runtime. create ticket and tag eng-ml for model-based pattern detection.

olivia: thanks all. filing follow-ups: PR to disable backfills, add log detector, post-incident review next Tue.

sanjay: thx. updating INC-2026-042 with timeline & artifacts.

jessica.comms: internal note ready, holding until legal approves language.

nate.legal: approved language for internal only. no external message.

olivia: last update — incident contained, no prod user tokens active, marking as mitigated.
